Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Screen widths
Body: Made four layouts for screen widths. The set up screen now scales with the screen widths (Medium, expanded, large and extra large).

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Made the number arrows work in Firefox
Body: -webkit-inner-spin-button doesn't work in Firefox so it's been replaced with plus and minus buttons.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Replaced tooltips with hints
Body: Peer testing showed that no one found out that hovering above anything will show tooltips so it's been replaced with hints.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Improved readability
Body: made text and edges easier to see, I used Claude and read WCAG website for this.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Update style.css
Body: Design tokens. Make sure everything is clean and easier for others to read.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Color session screen
Body: Added colors to session screen for different voices.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Added glow when bell rings
Body: In testing only 4 out of 12 clearly notice the bell and countdown was voted as the clearest but felt worse because of the numbers. So I'm adding a visual cue (glow) to the bell instead of a countdown.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Quick start
Body: one tester said the steps help you learn but they wouldn't want to do it every time so I added a quick start option.

Body: Many testers like the pad preview so I added preview to the voice too.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Showed voice descriptions
Body: Two testers asked what each voice sounds like. They were hidden in hover tooltips but I guess that was hard to discover so I added description under each voice instead.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Added error message if the sound can't start
Body: Wait 3 seconds and if no sound then it goes back to set up screen with a message.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Bell only rings when time runs out
Body: The bell now only rings when the time naturally runs out. The bell won't ring when the user manually ends the session anymore.
